dialogue.origin: おはようございます。
dialogue.content: Good morning.

dialogue.origin: おはようございます。
dialogue.content: Good morning.

dialogue.origin: まだロールプレイは慣れていないのですが、よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: I'm still not used to role-playing, but I look forward to working with you.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそ本日は、よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Likewise, thank you for your time today.

dialogue.origin: 時間になりましたので始めさせていただきます。
dialogue.content: It’s time, so I’d like to begin.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: おはようございます。ご相談ありがとうございます。はじめに年齢と性別、相談内容を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.content: Good morning. Thank you for reaching out. To start, could you tell me your age, gender, and what you’d like to talk about?

dialogue.origin: 13歳、女子友達から無視されてます
dialogue.content: I’m 13, female. My friends are ignoring me.

dialogue.origin: 中学生ですね。友達から無視されてるんですね。嫌な気分になりますよね。無視されてる、と感じるのはどんな時ですか？
dialogue.content: So you’re in middle school. Your friends are ignoring you. That must feel awful. When do you feel like you’re being ignored?

dialogue.origin: はい、普通に話ししてたのに急に冷たくされる
dialogue.content: Yes. We'll be talking normally, and then suddenly they'll act cold towards me.

dialogue.origin: それから、2、3日無視
dialogue.content: And then they'll ignore me for two or three days.

dialogue.origin: そして、急に普通になる
dialogue.content: And then, suddenly, things go back to normal.

dialogue.origin: 急に冷たくされて、何日か無視されたあと、またもとに戻る・・・とても不安になりますね。
dialogue.content: So they suddenly act cold, ignore you for a few days, and then go back to normal... That must be very unsettling.

dialogue.origin: はい、またされるんじゃ無いかって思っちゃう
dialogue.content: Yes, I keep thinking it's going to happen again.

dialogue.origin: なんどもあったらいやですよね。同じ友達からですか？何人か？
dialogue.content: It must be horrible for that to happen over and over. Is it from the same friend? Or several people?

dialogue.origin: 仲の良い友達6人、順番にある感じでその周りの子は無視されてる子話しかけて来れない
dialogue.content: It's a group of six close friends, and it's like they take turns. The other kids around us can't talk to the one being ignored.

dialogue.origin: 優しくしたら次にいじめられるから
dialogue.content: Because if they're nice, they'll be bullied next.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。誰かにやさしくしたから、あなたも無視れたのかな？
dialogue.content: I see. Is it possible that you were ignored because you were kind to someone?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: あ、他の友達が無視されてた時にやさしくしてあげたんですね。すごい勇気とやさしさですね。
dialogue.content: Oh, so when another friend was being ignored, you were kind to them. That was a very courageous and kind thing to do.

dialogue.origin: 先生に言ったのだけど…
dialogue.content: I told a teacher, but...

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: 先生に言ってあげたんですね。
dialogue.content: So you told the teacher for them.

dialogue.origin: その子…自分が　私にいじめられてるって泣いてたよって先生…
dialogue.content: The teacher said... that girl cried and said that I was the one bullying her.

dialogue.origin: 誤解してる
dialogue.content: They've misunderstood.

dialogue.origin: 誤解されてしまったのはショックですね。
dialogue.content: It must be a shock to be misunderstood like that.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 何にもできない
dialogue.content: There's nothing I can do.

dialogue.origin: その子がほかの友達からいじめられているとき、あなたはどんな風に感じた？
dialogue.content: When that girl was being bullied by the other friends, how did you feel?

dialogue.origin: 嫌だなぁって…
dialogue.content: I felt like... it was awful.

dialogue.origin: 嫌だなあって思ったんだよね。だから、自分はいじめたくないし、先生にお話した？
dialogue.content: You felt it was wrong, right? So because you didn't want to bully her yourself, you talked to the teacher?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: それは、とっても立派なことだし、勇気がいることだと思いますよ。
dialogue.content: That’s a very admirable and courageous thing to do.

dialogue.origin: 何もできない、って言ったけど、ちゃんと行動してる！
dialogue.content: You said you can’t do anything, but you actually took action!

dialogue.origin: でも、私もやらなきゃ　って思っていじめに参加してたし…
dialogue.content: But... I also participated in the bullying, thinking I had to...

dialogue.origin: そうなんだ。そのあと、その子とお話ししてみた？
dialogue.content: I see. Did you try talking to her after that?

dialogue.origin: そのあと…ずーっと　ムシされてます
dialogue.content: After that... I've been ignored ever since.

dialogue.origin: 話しかけようとしても、私に話しかけないでって　言われた
dialogue.content: Even when I tried to talk to her, she told me, “Don’t talk to me.”

dialogue.origin: それはつらいよね。2-3日したらまた普通に話するようになるって言ってたよね。もどってからはまた仲良しに？
dialogue.content: That must be so painful. You mentioned that after two or three days things usually go back to normal. When that happens, are you close friends again?

dialogue.origin: わからない…毎回、合わせるのに疲れます裏切り者って言われたし
dialogue.content: I don’t know... I’m exhausted from trying to go along with it every time. They even called me a traitor.

dialogue.origin: そんな風に友達から言われたら傷つきますね。
dialogue.content: It must be hurtful to be called that by your friends.

dialogue.origin: 本当に…疲れました
dialogue.content: Really... I'm exhausted.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、つかれちゃうよね。他に仲の良い友達とかはいますか？
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm, that would wear you out. Do you have any other close friends?

dialogue.origin: 他の人と仲良くしても、上手く行かないと思うから作らない
dialogue.content: Even if I try to get along with other people, I don't think it will go well, so I don't make new friends.

dialogue.origin: そうなんだね。つらい気持ちでストレスがたまってしまうね。
dialogue.content: I see. Those painful feelings must be building up a lot of stress.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 何か好きなこととか、気分転換になるようなことってある？
dialogue.content: Is there anything you enjoy doing, or something that helps you take your mind off things?

dialogue.origin: お菓子作りとか好きだけど何やっても　楽しくない
dialogue.content: I like baking sweets and such, but nothing feels fun right now.

dialogue.origin: お菓子作りが好きなんですねー、、、でも今は楽しくないよね。気分がのらないもんね。
dialogue.content: So you like baking... but it’s not enjoyable right now. You’re just not in the mood.

dialogue.origin: 学校…行きたくないなぁ
dialogue.content: School... I don’t want to go.

dialogue.origin: 行きたくないよね。おうちの人には、話してみた？
dialogue.content: I understand you don't want to go. Have you talked to anyone at home about it?

dialogue.origin: うん
dialogue.content: Yeah.

dialogue.origin: 誰に話してみた？
dialogue.content: Who did you talk to?

dialogue.origin: お母さん
dialogue.content: My mom.

dialogue.origin: お母さんは何て言ってた？
dialogue.content: What did your mom say?

dialogue.origin: 軽いケンカにしか思ってない
dialogue.content: She just thinks it's a small fight.

dialogue.origin: みんなで仲良くしなきゃねって
dialogue.content: She says, “You all need to get along.”

dialogue.origin: そうなんだね。そういわれても、そんなに簡単じゃないもんね。
dialogue.content: I see. Even if she says that, it's not that simple, is it?

dialogue.origin: だから、何にもできない
dialogue.content: That's why I can't do anything.

dialogue.origin: 学校行きたくないときは、無理に行かなくてもいいんじゃないかな？誰でもおなか痛くなったり、頭痛くなったりするもんね。私も経験あるし。
dialogue.content: When you don't want to go to school, maybe it's okay not to force yourself to go? Everyone gets a stomachache or a headache sometimes. I've been there too.

dialogue.origin: 仮病のね。
dialogue.content: You know, by faking sick.

dialogue.origin: 行かなくていいの
dialogue.content: Is it okay not to go?

dialogue.origin: 1日か2日は、休んでもイイんじゃないかな。
dialogue.content: I think it would be fine to take a day or two off.

dialogue.origin: それで、何か変わるかなぁ？
dialogue.content: Would that change anything?

dialogue.origin: お母さんに、しっかりお話して、学校に行きたくなくなるほど、いじめられている、っていうのをしっかりと分かってもらえないかな
dialogue.content: Do you think you could have a serious talk with your mom and make her understand that you're being bullied so badly you don't want to go to school?

dialogue.origin: どうだろう、しっかり、話したつもりだけど…
dialogue.content: I don't know... I feel like I did talk to her seriously...

dialogue.origin: 何にも変わらない
dialogue.content: Nothing changes.

dialogue.origin: 元気付けてくれるけど
dialogue.content: She tries to cheer me up, but...

dialogue.origin: 何にも変わらない
dialogue.content: Nothing changes.

dialogue.origin: （ごめんなさい。ちょっとわからなくなってしまいました。時間が延長できませんので、終了させていただけますでしょうか）
dialogue.content: (I'm sorry. I've become a bit lost. Since we can't extend the time, would it be alright if we finish here?)

dialogue.origin: ロールプレイお疲れ様でした。
dialogue.content: Thank you for the role-play session.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました。失礼致します。
dialogue.content: Thank you very much. Goodbye.

dialogue.origin: もっとよーく勉強して、考えます。
dialogue.content: I'll study more and think about it carefully.

topic.sub: 友達からのいじめへの対処方法
